description: Early-to-middle positions with a low, centre-left cluster: my stones on the bottom of columns 3-4 and at row 2 of column 3, the opponent's stones directly on top at row 1 of columns 3/4 and flanking on the bottom row at columns 2 and 5, with cell (2,4) still empty. Any stone at (2,4), my stones on row 1 right of centre, or tall outer columns switch it off. Graded, additive; no single cell is sufficient.
effect: None measurable: zeroing it on 4 firing positions or forcing it to max on 3 others moves move probabilities by at most ~8 points, with no consistent column.
notes: Best dev F1 0.322 (P 0.34, R 0.30, AUROC 0.785), simulation share 0.10, from a hand-weighted cell score. Hard rule on their (1,3)+my (2,3)+empty (2,4) gave F1 0.20; alternating-stripe idea 0.28. Board-based (move order irrelevant), mover-frame, not translation invariant; misses include colour-swapped centre cells (e.g. 2,5,4,3,3,5 fires 1.4). Looks like a distributed/mixture direction; possibly a random direction. Synthesis max 5.05 < dev max 5.43.
